title: C2: A cube root of two
title_html: C2: A cube root of two
html:
Let τ:={p∈Q:p≤0 or p3<2}. We show that τ is a cut with τ>D0 and that τττ=D2. Everything below is proved in full except the last case, which is left to you.

Monotone cubing. For rationals 0≤a<b, b3−a3=(b−a)(b2+ab+a2)>0, since b−a>0, b2>0 (@prp-ordered-ring-rules (e)), ab≥0, a2≥0, and a product of positives is positive (@prp-ordered-ring-rules (c)). Only non-negative a,b are needed, because of the clause “p≤0 or”.

τ is a cut and τ>D0. (C1) 0∈τ, and 2∉τ since 23=8≥2. (C2) Let q<p∈τ. If q≤0, then q∈τ. If 0<q<p, then p>0, so p3<2, and monotone cubing gives q3<p3<2. (C3) If p≤0, then 1∈τ is larger. If p>0 and p3<2, put d:=2−p3, so 0<d≤2, and h:=d3p2+3p+2. Then 0<h<1, because d≤2<3p2+3p+2. So h2<h and h3<h, and since p>0, (p+h)3=p3+3p2h+3ph2+h3<p3+h(3p2+3p+1)<p3+h(3p2+3p+2)=p3+d=2, so p+h∈τ and p+h>p. Finally D0⊆τ and 1∈τ∖D0, so τ>D0.

The ⊆ half of τττ=D2. Since τ>D0, the proof of @prp-cut-product-positive (c), with α=β=γ=τ, shows that (ττ)τ=τ(ττ) (so we write τττ) is the set of x∈Q with x≤rst for some positive r,s,t∈τ. For such r,s,t, let m be the largest. Then rst≤m3<2, by @prp-ordered-ring-rules (c) and monotone cubing. So τττ⊆D2.

The ⊇ half, easy cases. Let x<1. Then 1∈τ (13<2) and x≤1⋅1⋅1, so x∈τττ. This covers x≤0 and 0<x<1 together.

The ⊇ half, the case 1≤x<2. Let 1≤x<2. Find r∈τ, r>0, with r3>x, and then write x as a product of three positive elements of τ.

Name the move, then complete it.
